caption:
Peonies before seven. The city can have me after.

#newyorkcity #flowermarket #peonies
alt_text: From behind on a wet flower-market sidewalk at blue hour: a woman whose bare arm and carved updo are polished grey-ivory marble with thin gold veins walks past buckets of white peonies and tulips, a garnet coat over her shoulders and a slate knit dress.
